title: Open Mic Wednesdays @ Original Grinds
event_description: A weekly open mic in a cozy vegan coffee shop and sober venue welcoming every genre from acoustic singer-songwriters to hip hop. Sign up at the counter and grab a seat for a laid-back night of local talent.
event_venue_information:
Original Grinds

Original Grinds is an indie, plant-based coffee shop and sober venue on Caroline Street in downtown Fredericksburg, doubling as a vegan bakery, small art gallery and community stage. It has quickly become one of the few alcohol-free spaces in town built specifically around live performance.

Open Mic Wednesdays

Every Wednesday night the shop clears floor space for Open Mic Wednesdays, a free, all-ages show that welcomes acoustic singer-songwriters, hip hop artists, poets and anything in between. Sign-ups open at 7:00 PM with the show starting at 7:30 PM, and sets typically run about 10 minutes, though the night has been known to stretch past 10:00 PM “if the talent is flowin.”

Other Events

Original Grinds also hosts Breaking Lines, a recurring poetry and spoken word night, along with rotating art shows from local painters. Because the shop is sober and coffee-forward, it draws a noticeably younger and more all-ages crowd than the bar-based open mics elsewhere downtown.

Good to Know

Original Grinds is located at 615 Caroline Street, Fredericksburg, VA, a short walk from the Rappahannock riverfront. Purchasing a drink or food item is appreciated to support the free weekly show.

title: Jazz Jam @ Curitiba Art Cafe
event_description: The Fredericksburg Jazz Collective hosts this all-ages jazz jam on the second Thursday of each month. A rotating host band opens with a short set before musicians and singers sign up to sit in.
hosts: Fredericksburg Jazz Collective; sign-ups facilitated by guitarist Bruce Middle
event_venue_information:
Curitiba Art Cafe

Curitiba Art Cafe is a Brazilian-inspired coffee house and wine bar on Caroline Street, built around specialty espresso, small plates and a “people first” approach to supporting local artists. Indoor seating surrounds a small stage area, and a patio out back adds extra room on busy nights.

Fredericksburg Jazz Collective Jazz Jam

On the second Thursday of every month, Curitiba becomes home to the Fredericksburg Jazz Collective's all-ages jazz jam, from 7:00 PM to 10:00 PM. A rotating host band opens with a roughly 40-minute set, after which guitarist Bruce Middle helps pair up musicians and singers who want to sit in. Players are encouraged to register in small groups and perform two or three tunes, though solo sign-ups are welcome too. The nonprofit collective, which moved here in 2024 after a decade at Colonial Tavern, uses jam donations to support jazz education for area students.

Other Events

Beyond the monthly jazz jam, Curitiba's calendar includes live acoustic sets, comedy nights, drag performances and community art gatherings, along with regular use by local writing and photography groups.

Good to Know

Curitiba Art Cafe is located at 919 Caroline Street, Fredericksburg, VA. Because the jazz jam is monthly rather than weekly, check the Fredericksburg Jazz Collective's calendar to confirm the date before visiting.

title: Open Mic Night @ Adventure Brewing North
event_description: A come-as-you-are open mic held every other week at this Fredericksburg brewery for musicians, comedians and poets alike. House PA, mics and a loaner acoustic guitar are ready for anyone who signs up.
backline: House PA with two 250-watt speakers and a monitor, two to three vocal or instrument microphones, and a 16-channel soundboard with XLR, 1/4-inch and AUX inputs; a loaner acoustic guitar is available
event_venue_information:
Adventure Brewing North

Adventure Brewing North is a spacious craft brewery and taproom on the north side of Fredericksburg, known for its rotating beer lineup and a steady calendar of live music, trivia and community events.

Open Mic Night

Held every other week, typically from 7:00 PM to 9:30 PM, the open mic is open to musicians, comedians and poets of every skill level. Sign-ups begin at 6:30 PM, and performers generally get 10 to 15 minutes on stage. The taproom supplies a house PA with two 250-watt speakers and a monitor, two to three vocal and instrument microphones, and a 16-channel soundboard accepting XLR, 1/4-inch and AUX inputs; a loaner acoustic guitar is also available for anyone who needs one.

Other Events

Adventure Brewing North also books live bands most Friday and Saturday nights and runs a regular trivia night; touring musicians and local acts can reach the taproom's booking team directly to pitch a slot.

Good to Know

Adventure Brewing North is located at 33 Perchwood Drive, Unit 101, Fredericksburg, VA. Because the open mic runs biweekly, confirm the next date on the brewery's event calendar before heading over.

title: Open Mic Night @ Colonial Beach Brewing
event_description: Most Thursday evenings host Brian Jarboe opens the mic at this small-batch brewery in a converted garage in historic downtown Colonial Beach, about 30 minutes from Fredericksburg.
event_venue_information:
Colonial Beach Brewing

Colonial Beach Brewing is a small-batch brewery tucked into a converted service garage in historic downtown Colonial Beach, about a 30-minute drive from Fredericksburg along the Northern Neck. The intimate, garage-turned-taproom space has a casual, hometown feel.

Open Mic Night

Most Thursday evenings starting around 6:00 PM, local musician Brian Jarboe hosts an open mic that draws pickers, singers and regulars from around the small riverside town. It is a low-key, drop-in affair rather than a strictly ticketed show.

Other Events

Colonial Beach Brewing also books touring and local bands on select Friday and Saturday nights throughout the year.

Good to Know

Colonial Beach Brewing is located at 215C Washington Avenue, Colonial Beach, VA. Because the open mic runs on a most-Thursdays rather than guaranteed-weekly basis, it is worth a quick call or a check of the brewery's Facebook page before making the drive.
